basics.name: Zilai Li
basics.label: Independent Researcher & Software Engineer
basics.summary: Independent researcher and software engineer focusing on efficient generative modeling, fast ODE/SDE solvers for diffusion models, training-free diffusion distillation enhancement, and lightweight semantic watermark extraction. Contributor to Hugging Face Diffusers with interactive model demos hosted on Hugging Face Spaces (coralLight).

work.name: Independent Research
work.summary: Conducting independent research on diffusion models, fast numerical ODE solvers, diffusion distillation diversity, and generative AI trustworthiness.
highlights: RAIN (BMVC 2026 TrustVis Workshop, Oral): Proposed a prompt-free, U-Net-free, dual-branch NAFNet architecture for one-step Gaussian-Shading semantic watermark extraction, achieving 47.4x fewer FLOPs (14.394 GFLOPs), 56x fewer parameters (15.468M), and 1.39 ms/image parallel inference (22.5x-26.8x speedup over OSI and FARI) with 99.99% clean bit accuracy.

F-scheduler (Under Review at TMLR): Designed a training-free time and Free-U skip-connection schedule for few-step diffusion ODE solvers (UniPC, DPM++ 2M), generating 1024x1024 SDXL images in 6 steps and 512x512 SD 1.5 images in 5 steps while outperforming SOTA distillation models (e.g., DMD2 LoRA) and 20-step DPM++ 2M in FID.

EMPURPLE (Preprint): Analyzed mode collapse and train-test distribution shift in distilled diffusion models via a PAC-style generalization bound and the Information Bottleneck principle; proposed a training-free intermediate-latent recycling algorithm that improves FID by 7%-20% across DMD2 (+20% FID), Hyper-SD, FlashSD, and SDXL-Lightning.
Open-Source & Community Demos: Contributed a merged scheduler bug fix to Hugging Face Diffusers (PR #14011) and deployed interactive Gradio demos on Hugging Face Spaces (coralLight).

work.name: Industry Software Engineering
work.summary: Full-time software development engineer building production client architectures, interactive UI/animation pipelines, and high-performance application systems alongside independent AI research.
highlights: Architected modular application components, asynchronous state management (MVVM), and high-frame-rate rendering workflows.
Built reproducible evaluation pipelines, multi-GPU CUDA stream inference benchmarks, and interactive Gradio web applications for generative vision models.
Postgraduate coursework and research in computer vision, machine learning, and software engineering at Jubilee Campus.

publications.name: RAIN: Region-Aware Inversion Network for Semantic Watermark Extraction
publications.publisher: BMVC 2026 Workshop on Trustworthy Visual Computing (TrustVis) — Accepted for Oral Presentation (arXiv:2609.14856)
publications.summary: A lightweight, prompt-free, one-step semantic watermark extractor that decomposes high-SNR endpoint recovery into parallel anchor and residual NAFNet branches. Reduces compute by 47.4x (14.394 GFLOPs vs. ~680 GFLOPs) and latency to 1.39 ms/image while matching 50-step DDIM Inversion accuracy (99.99%) and maintaining robustness across 10 image distortions.

publications.name: F-scheduler: Illuminating the Free-Lunch Design Space for Fast Sampling of Diffusion Models
publications.publisher: Under Review at Transactions on Machine Learning Research (TMLR) (arXiv:2510.02390)
publications.summary: Proposes a training-free ODE solver time schedule that preserves terminal KL-regularized latent variance for the beta-VAE decoder and coordinates stage-wise Free-U Net skip-connection modulation. Achieves 6-step 1024x1024 and 5-step 512x512 generation with UniPC and DPM++ 2M, outperforming SOTA diffusion distillation models and 20-step solvers in FID.

publications.name: EMPURPLE: A Free Lunch for Diffusion Distillation based on the Information Bottleneck
publications.summary: Establishes a PAC-style theoretical link between aggressive early-step velocity redirection and intermediate latent distribution shift in diffusion distillation. Introduces a model-agnostic, training-free latent recycling method that restores generation diversity and improves FID by 7%-20% across DMD2, Hyper-SD, FlashSD, and SDXL-Lightning.

projects.name: RAIN: One-Step Semantic Watermark Extraction
projects.summary: Official PyTorch implementation and theoretical notes for RAIN (Accepted Oral at BMVC 2026 TrustVis Workshop).
highlights: Concurrent dual-stream NAFNet inference (14.394 GFLOPs, 15.468M params, 1.39 ms/image on dual NVIDIA A800 GPUs).
Includes closed-form Test-Function & Taylor expansion proof explaining why endpoint-jumping distilled models (LCM/DMD2) cannot use deterministic DDIM Inversion.

projects.name: F-scheduler: Fast Training-Free ODE Sampling for Diffusion Models
projects.summary: Training-free scheduler for 5-6 step high-resolution diffusion sampling (Under Review at TMLR), with interactive Hugging Face Spaces.
highlights: Live interactive demos on Hugging Face Spaces: DMD2 vs. F-Scheduler, F-scheduler 4K, F-scheduler DreamshaperXL, and F-scheduler Animation.
Outperforms DMD2 LoRA in structural detail and texture fidelity using Analytical First Step (AFS) + custom timestep scheduling.

projects.name: EMPURPLE: Training-Free Diversity Enhancement for Distilled Diffusion Models
projects.summary: Training-free intermediate-latent recycling to eliminate mode collapse in few-step distilled diffusion samplers.
highlights: Live interactive comparison on Hugging Face Spaces (coralLight/EMPURPLE) and Google Colab Demo.
Reuses cached noisy latents (e.g., SDXL UniPC at timestep 852) to boost FID by up to 20% on DMD2 without retraining.

projects.name: Hugging Face Diffusers Open-Source Contribution
projects.summary: Merged scheduler bug fix for the Hugging Face Diffusers library.
highlights: Merged PR #14011: Fixed custom timestep shifting inconsistency in FlowMatchEulerDiscreteScheduler.set_timesteps when shift != 1, ensuring consistency between custom timesteps and num_inference_steps schedules for Rectified Flow / Flow Matching solvers.
